verses: Dil khush kun chalti hawaon ki qasam
Phir zor say jhonka denay waliyon ki qasam
Phir (abar ko) ubhaar ker paragandah kerney waliyon ki qasam
Phir haq o baatil ko juda juda ker denay walay
Aur wahee laney walay farishton ki qasam
Jo (wahee) ilzam utarnay ya aagah kerdenay kay liye hoti hai
Jiss cheez ka tum say wada kiya jata hai woh yaqeenan honey wali hai
Pus jab sitaray bey noor kerdiey jayen gay
Aur jab aasman tor phor diya jaye ga
Aur jab pahar tukray tukray ker kay ura diye jayen gay
Aur jab rasoolon ko waqt muqarrara per laya jaye ga
Kiss din kay liye (unn sab ko) moakhir kiya gaya hai?
Faislay kay din kay liye
Aur tujhay kiya maloom kay faislay ka din kiya hai?
Uss din jhutlanay walon ki kharabi hai
Kiya hum ney aglon ko halak nahi kiya?
Phir hum unn kay baad pichlon ko laye
Hum gunehgaron kay sath ussi tarah kertay hain
Uss din jhutlanay walon kay liye well (afsos) hai
Kiya hum ney tumhen haqeer pani say (mani say) peda nahi kiya
Phir hum ney ussay mazboot o mehfooz jagah mein rakha
Aik muqarrara waqt tak
Phir hum ney andaza kiya aur hum kiya khoob andaza kerney walay hain
Uss din takzeeb kerney walon ki kharabi hai
Kiya hum ney zamin ko sametnay wali nahi banaya?
Zindon ko bhi aur mardon ko bhi
Aur hum ney uss mein buland o bhari pahar bana aur tumhen seraab kerney wala meetha pani pilaya
Uss din jhutlanay walon kay liye waaye aur afsos hai
Uss dozakh ki taraf jao jissay tum jhutlatay rahey thay
Chalo teen shakhon walay saye ki taraf
Jo dar asal na saya denay wala hai aur na sholay say bacha sakta hai
Yaqeenan dozakh chingariyan phenkti hai jo misil mehal kay hain
Goya kay woh zard oont hain
Aaj unn jhutlanay walon ki durgat hai
Aaj (ka din) woh din hai kay yeh bol bhi na saken gay
Na unhen maazrat ki ijazat di jaye gi
Uss din jhutlanay walon ki kharabi hai
Yeh hai faislay ka din hum ney tumhen aur aglon ko sab ko jama kerliya hai
Pus agar tum mujh say koi chaal chal saktay ho to chal lo
Waaye hai uss din jhutlanay walon kay liye
Be-shak perhezgar log sayon mein hain aur behtay chashmon mein
Aur unn mewon mein jin ki woh khuwahish keren
(aey jannatiyon!)khao!) khao piyo mazay apney kiye huye aemaal kay badlay
Yaqeenan hum neki kerney walon ko ussi tarah jaza detay hain
Uss din sacha na jannay walon kay liye well (afsos) hai
(aey jhutlanay walo) tum duniya mein thora sa kha lo aur faeedah utha lo be-shak tum gunehgar ho
Uss din jhutlanay walon kay liye sakht halakat hai
Unn say jab kaha jata hai kay rukoo ker lo to nahi kertay
Uss din jhutlanay walon ki tabahi hai
Abb uss Quran kay baad kiss baat per eman layen gay?
